title: AutoInfer run test-3: Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 on 2x RTX 4090
subtitle: Handoff packet after round 3 of 5 (stopped at the human checkpoint). Goal: output tok/s at concurrency 16, same math as the baseline.

nodes.title: Prefill graph cap 96 → 2048 (flag)
nodes.takeaway: Graphing prefill steps alone barely helps: they are GPU-bound, not CPU-bound.

nodes.title: Host-staged 2-rank AR
nodes.takeaway: A custom all-reduce through pinned host memory beats NCCL on this no-P2P box; bitwise equal to NCCL.

nodes.title: Diagnosis (nsys + microbench)
nodes.takeaway: Diagnosis: decode AR near its PCIe floor; prefill-step AR time is mostly rank skew (later traced to GPU 0's locked clock).

nodes.title: + host-staged all-gather
nodes.takeaway: Moving the logits all-gather to the host path is a wash on its own; kept as a building block.

nodes.title: + prefill graph flag
nodes.takeaway: The host AR and the prefill-graph flag stack super-additively: champion of round 1.

nodes.title: + local-argmax drafts (flag)
nodes.takeaway: Draft tokens via local argmax instead of gathering full draft logits: small, real.

nodes.title: + FP8 draft lm_head (flag)
nodes.takeaway: FP8 draft head (drafter only, allowed by ruling 1) costs no acceptance.

nodes.title: 3 draft tokens
nodes.takeaway: 3 draft tokens fail, later diagnosed as capacity: only 14 of 16 requests fit in the KV pool.

nodes.title: + greedy verification fast path
nodes.takeaway: Greedy verification gathers (max, argmax) instead of full logits; exact incl. ties. Current champion.

directions.title: R3: spec-decode capacity + GDN state traffic

nodes.title: k=3 + KV 5.5–6.0 GiB
nodes.takeaway: 3 draft tokens with a bigger KV budget: OOM during CUDA-graph capture.

nodes.title: k=3 + KV 5.6 GiB + fewer graphs
nodes.takeaway: Trimming graphs to make room: runtime OOM. KV ~5.0 GiB is the ceiling.

nodes.title: GDN state checkpoint + replay
nodes.takeaway: GDN layers write one recurrent state per step instead of k+1 (replay); bitwise exact. +2.6%: below the 3% bar.
